Subject: Demo for BlueHorizon — cross-region availability and DST note

Hi Emily / David —

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood. We’re excited to run a 45-minute product demo next week that includes a short walkthrough and time for your engineering and security folks. Because this demo will include folks in the US and EU (and potentially APAC observers), I wanted to flag the US daylight savings changeover happening on Sunday, Mar 8. That will move US calendars forward one hour while EU calendars stay unchanged until late March, which can cause participants to see different times in invites.

Proposed slots (all shown in both ET and CET):
- Tue Mar 10 — 10:00 ET / 15:00 CET (45 min)
- Wed Mar 11 — 09:00 ET / 14:00 CET (45 min)
- Wed Mar 11 — 16:00 ET / 21:00 CET (45 min) — late for EU, option for US night shift

If you prefer we can anchor the invite on UTC to avoid client-side calendar shifts (e.g., 15:00 CET = 14:00 UTC) — we'll send the invite with explicit UTC + local times and an .ics.

Attached: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (brief agenda). I’ve also added a draft mutual action plan for next steps (mutual-action-plan-bh.docx).

Quick asks:
1) Which slot works best for your team?
2) Do you want us to send an invite anchored to UTC?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Marcus and Tessa on availability.

— Kimberly
